                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            } else {

                                $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                            }

                    } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
                        $spillReplacement = 'ANCHORARRAY(' . $cellReference . ')';
                    }
                }
                $spillConverted .= $spillReplacement;
                $scanIndex = $spillOffset + strlen($spillText);
            } else {
                $spillConverted .= substr($prefixedFormula, $scanIndex);
                $scanIndex = $formulaLength;
            }
        }
        $prefixedFormula = $spillConverted;

        $parsedTokenCount = 0;
        try {
            $formulaParser = new FormulaParser('=' . $prefixedFormula);
            $parsedTokenCount = $formulaParser->getTokenCount();
            if ($parsedTokenCount > 0) {
                $parsedFormulaText = $formulaParser->getFormula();
                if ($parsedFormulaText !== '') {
                    $parsedTokenCount = $formulaParser->getTokenCount();
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
            $parsedTokenCount = 0;
        }

        $identifiedFunctions = [];
        $functionScanOffset = 0;
        $functionScanLength = strlen($prefixedFormula);
        $functionPattern = '/' . Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_FUNCTION . '/mui';
        while ($functionScanOffset < $functionScanLength) {
            if (preg_match($functionPattern, $prefixedFormula, $functionMatch, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $functionScanOffset) === 1) {
                $functionPosition = (int) $functionMatch[0][1];
                $rawFunctionName = $functionMatch[1][0] ?? '';
                if ($rawFunctionName !== '') {
                    $normalizedName = StringHelper::strToLower($rawFunctionName);
                    $normalizedName = (string) preg_replace('/^(?:_xlfn\.)?(?:_xlws\.)?/i', '', $normalizedName);
                    if ($normalizedName !== '') {
                        $identifiedFunctions[] = $normalizedName;
                    }
                }
                $functionScanOffset = $functionPosition + max(1, strlen($functionMatch[0][0]));
            } else {
                $functionScanOffset = $functionScanLength;
            }
        }

        $xlfnOutput = '';
        $xlfnOffset = 0;
        $xlfnLength = strlen($prefixedFormula);
        while ($xlfnOffset < $xlfnLength) {
            if (preg_match(self::XLFNREGEXP, $prefixedFormula, $xlfnMatch, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $xlfnOffset) === 1) {
                $matchPosition = (int) $xlfnMatch[0][1];
                $matchText = $xlfnMatch[0][0];
                $capturedBody = $xlfnMatch[1][0];
                if ($matchPosition > $xlfnOffset) {
                    $xlfnOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlfnOffset, $matchPosition - $xlfnOffset);
                }
                $functionCore = StringHelper::strToLower((string) preg_replace('/^(?:_xlws\.)?/i', '', $capturedBody));
                $parserRecognized = false;
                if ($parsedTokenCount > 0 && $identifiedFunctions !== []) {
                    foreach ($identifiedFunctions as $identifiedFunction) {
                        if ($identifiedFunction === $functionCore) {
                            $parserRecognized = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (strncasecmp($matchText, '_xlfn.', 6) === 0) {
                    $xlfnOutput .= '_xlfn.' . $capturedBody . '(';
                } elseif ($parserRecognized) {
                    $xlfnOutput .= '_xlfn.' . $capturedBody . '(';
                } else {
                    $xlfnOutput .= '_xlfn.' . $capturedBody . '(';
                }
                $xlfnOffset = $matchPosition + strlen($matchText);
            } else {
                $xlfnOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlfnOffset);
                $xlfnOffset = $xlfnLength;
            }
        }
        $prefixedFormula = $xlfnOutput;

        $xlwsOutput = '';
        $xlwsOffset = 0;
        $xlwsLength = strlen($prefixedFormula);
        while ($xlwsOffset < $xlwsLength) {
            if (preg_match(self::XLWSREGEXP, $prefixedFormula, $xlwsMatch, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE, $xlwsOffset) === 1) {
                $matchPosition = (int) $xlwsMatch[0][1];
                $matchText = $xlwsMatch[0][0];
                $capturedName = $xlwsMatch[1][0];
                if ($matchPosition > $xlwsOffset) {
                    $xlwsOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlwsOffset, $matchPosition - $xlwsOffset);
                }
                $normalizedWsName = StringHelper::strToLower($capturedName);
                $parserRecognizedWs = false;
                if ($identifiedFunctions !== []) {
                    foreach ($identifiedFunctions as $identifiedFunction) {
                        if ($identifiedFunction === $normalizedWsName) {
                            $parserRecognizedWs = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if ($normalizedWsName === 'filter') {
                    $xlwsOutput .= '_xlws.' . $capturedName . '(';
                } elseif ($normalizedWsName === 'sort') {
                    $xlwsOutput .= '_xlws.' . $capturedName . '(';
                } elseif ($parserRecognizedWs) {
                    $xlwsOutput .= '_xlws.' . $capturedName . '(';
                } else {
                    $xlwsOutput .= '_xlws.' . $capturedName . '(';
                }
                $xlwsOffset = $matchPosition + strlen($matchText);
            } else {
                $xlwsOutput .= substr($prefixedFormula, $xlwsOffset);
                $xlwsOffset = $xlwsLength;
            }
        }

        return $xlwsOutput;
    }

    /**
     * Prefix function name in string with _xlfn. where required.
     * Leading character, expected to be equals sign, is stripped.
     */
    public static function addFunctionPrefixStripEquals(string $functionString): string
    {
        return self::addFunctionPrefix(substr($functionString, 1));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheetTests\Writer\Xlsx;

use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx\FunctionPrefix;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class FunctionPrefixTest extends TestCase
{
    /**
     * @dataProvider functionPrefixProvider
     */
    public function testFunctionPrefix(string $expectedResult, string $functionString): void
    {
        $result = FunctionPrefix::addFunctionPrefix($functionString);
        self::assertSame($expectedResult, $result);
        $result = FunctionPrefix::addFunctionPrefixStripEquals("=$functionString");
        self::assertSame($expectedResult, $result);
    }

    public static function functionPrefixProvider(): array
    {
        return [
            'Basic Legacy Function' => ['SUM()', 'SUM()'],
            'New Function without Prefix' => ['_xlfn.ARABIC()', 'ARABIC()'],
            'New Function already Prefixed' => ['_xlfn.ARABIC()', '_xlfn.ARABIC()'],
            'New Function requiring Double-Prefix' => ['_xlfn._xlws.FILTER()', 'FILTER()'],
            'New Function requiring Double-Prefix already partially Prefixed' => ['_xlfn._xlws.FILTER()', '_xlfn.FILTER()'],
            'New Function requiring Double-Prefix already partially Prefixed #2' => ['_xlfn._xlws.FILTER()', '_xlws.FILTER()'],
            'New Function requiring Double-Prefix already Fully Prefixed' => ['_xlfn._xlws.FILTER()', '_xlfn._xlws.FILTER()'],
            'Multiple Functions' => ['_xlfn._xlws.SORT(_xlfn._xlws.FILTER(A:A, A:A<>""))', 'SORT(FILTER(A:A, A:A<>""))'],
            'DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 1' => ['_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY())', 'DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY())'],
            'DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 2' => ['_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY())', '_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY())'],
            'DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 3' => ['ABS(_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY()))', 'ABS(DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY()))'],
            'DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 4' => ['ABS(_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY()))', 'ABS(_xlfn.DAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY()))'],
            'DAYS/NETWORKDAYS 5' => ['NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY(), C:C)', 'NETWORKDAYS(DATE(2023,1,1),TODAY(), C:C)'],
            'COUNTIFS reclassified as Legacy' => ['COUNTIFS()', 'COUNTIFS()'],
            'SUMIFS reclassified as Legacy' => ['SUMIFS()', 'SUMIFS()'],
        ];
    }
}
